# Albert's Imagebook

> Albert's Imagebook is an open-source Codex Skill that transforms personal, portrait and travel
> photos into 24 reusable illustration, sticker, paper, print, collage and pixel-art styles.

Repository: https://github.com/AlbertAZ1992/albert-imagebook
License: MIT
Skill name: albert-imagebook
Current library: 24 photo-to-art styles
Default output: one 1080x1440 portrait artwork with no added text

## Install

Run:

    npx --yes skills@1.5.24 add AlbertAZ1992/albert-imagebook \
      --skill albert-imagebook --global --agent codex --yes

Then start a new Codex task, attach a photo, and ask:

    Use $albert-imagebook. Turn this photo into Impasto Island, no text.

## What it can do

- Transform a photo into an illustration, sticker, paper cutout, print, collage or pixel artwork.
- Recommend suitable styles after inspecting the source photograph.
- Export exact 3:4, 4:5, 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9 PNG files.
- Compose original-versus-art comparisons with exact 50:50 panels.
- Process multiple photos or styles while keeping every source independent.

## Included styles

A Few Lines, Arched Memory, Blue Hour Print, Clean Comic, Crayon Notes, Quiet Acrylic,
Enamel Keepsake, Geometric Card, Grain Print, Impasto Island, Little Day Stickers, Navy Outline,
Painterly Stories, Paper Poetry, Pastel Reverie, Photo Play, Pixel Coast, Retro Flat, Riso Weekend,
Travel Stamps, Summer Wordscape, Threaded Memory, Watercolor Light, and Weekend Cutouts.

## Product boundary

Albert's Imagebook provides the reusable Skill, style directions and exact-size export workflow.
It requires a Skill-compatible host with image generation or editing. The Skill does not include
an image model or image credits.
